title: Connection issue with Dana-i pump (Korean version)
symptom: The Dana-i pump appears in the Bluetooth list and briefly reacts when attempting to connect from AAPS, but the connection drops within seconds. The log shows 'queue empty. disconnect' and 'disconnected'.
cause: The issue is caused by Easy Mode being enabled on the Korean Dana-i pump, which prevents proper communication with AAPS.
fix: Turn off Easy Mode on the pump by pressing and holding the three buttons except 'OK', entering the password 3022, and then selecting the option to turn off Easy Mode. After that, AAPS connected and worked normally.
evidence_quote: The issue was caused by Easy Mode not being turned off. To disable it: press and hold the three buttons except "OK", enter the password 3022, and you will find the option to turn off Easy Mode. After that, AAPS connected and worked normally.
